Name: FarmOverview
Author: secsky3
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b]Farm Overview[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]In-Game Full Farm Bird's-Eye View & Real-Time Farm Planning[/i][/size]

[url=https://github.com/qotnl111/FarmOverview][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Open--Source-black?style=flat&logo=github[/img][/url]  [url=https://ko-fi.com/secsky3][img]https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg[/img][/url]
[/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]✨ Why Farm Overview?[/b][/size]
Tired of quitting your game or relying on external web planners just to check and design your farm layout?
[b]Farm Overview[/b] lets you view your [b]entire farm on a single screen directly in-game[/b], pause time to inspect your layout, and place items from above!

[line]

[size=5][b]📢 What's New in v1.0.1[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Day/Night & Weather Effects[/b]: The overview mode now fully respects dynamic ambient lighting and atmospheric weather effects.[/*]
[*][b]Area Zoom (Box Zoom)[/b]: While paused, simply right-click and drag over any area to zoom in on it for detailed inspection. Right-click again to reset the view.[/*]
[*][b]Configurable Settings[/b]: Area zoom and visual behavior can be customized via the GMCM config menu.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]🌟 Key Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]🦅 One-Touch Farm Overview (F8)[/b]: Instantly view your entire farm, town, or any map on your screen. Perfect for checking crop layouts, path symmetry, and building placements without leaving the game.[/*]
[*][b]⏸️ Freeze & Tile Inspection (Space)[/b]: Press [b]Space Bar[/b] in overview mode to completely freeze game time and all animations. Relax, plan your layout, and hover over any tile to see its exact [b](<X, Y>) coordinates[/b] in real-time.[/*]
[*][b]🔍 Area Zoom in Pause Mode[/b]: Right-click and drag across any section while paused to zoom in close. Right-click once more to snap back to the full overview.[/*]
[*][b]📦 Place Items Directly from Bird's-Eye View[/b]: Place chests, machines, fences, paths, and crops directly while viewing the whole farm. Grid guides and transparent previews automatically scale to match the overview![/*]
[*][b]⚡ Smooth Performance[/b]: Background caching prevents heavy stuttering and frame drops during normal overview movement.[/*]
[*][b]🎬 Cutscene & Warp Safety[/b]: Automatically turns off during events/cutscenes to keep cameras intact, and seamlessly recalibrates when moving between maps.[/*]
[*][b]⚙️ GMCM Support[/b]: Easily customize hotkeys and zoom preferences in the in-game settings menu.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]🎮 Controls[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]F8[/b] : Toggle Bird's-Eye Overview On / Off (Configurable)[/*]
[*][b]Space[/b] : Pause / Resume time & animations in overview mode to inspect tiles[/*]
[*][b]Right-Click & Drag[/b] : Box-select an area to zoom in (Available while paused)[/*]
[*][b]Right-Click[/b] : Reset zoom back to full overview / Exit zoom mode[/*]
[*][b]Esc[/b] : Exit pause mode or overview[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]📥 Requirements & Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (v4.0.0 or higher, Stardew Valley 1.6+).[/*]
[*]Download this mod and place the [b]FarmOverview[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI![/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]🤝 Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Custom Maps[/b]: Fully compatible with custom farm layouts, Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE), and Ridgeside Village.[/*]
[*][b]UI Mods[/b]: Compatible with UIInfoSuite2, DynamicReflections, etc.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]🇰🇷 한국어 안내[/b][/size]
[b]📌 v1.0.1 업데이트 내용[/b]
[list]
[*]이제 조감도 모드에서 낮/밤 조명 및 날씨 효과가 정상적으로 지원됩니다.[/*]
[*]일시정지 상태에서 우클릭 드래그로 원하는 영역을 지정해 부분 확대할 수 있으며, 다시 우클릭하면 원래 크기로 복귀합니다.[/*]
[*]부분 확대 관련 옵션은 인게임 모드 설정(GMCM)에서 자유롭게 변경 가능합니다.[/*]
[/list]
[b]주요 기능[/b]
[list]
[*][b]제작 목적[/b]: 농장 배치와 동선을 구상할 때 매번 게임을 종료하고 외부 플래너를 켤 필요 없이, 인게임에서 즉시 전경을 확인하고 설계할 수 있도록 제작된 모드입니다.[/*]
[*][b]F8 키[/b]: 현재 맵 전체 조감도 On/Off 토글[/*]
[*][b]Space 키[/b]: 조감도 상태에서 게임 시간과 애니메이션을 완전히 멈추고 타일 좌표(X, Y)를 확인하며 여유롭게 농장 구조를 점검하는 일시정지 기능[/*]
[*][b]부분 확대 (우클릭 드래그)[/b]: 일시정지 중 원하는 구역을 드래그하여 확대 관찰 가능 (다시 우클릭 시 해제)[/*]
[*][b]조감도 상태 아이템 설치[/b]: 축소된 조감도 화면에서도 상자, 가공기, 울타리, 바닥재 등을 제자리에서 실시간으로 직접 배치 가능[/*]
[*][b]GMCM 지원[/b]: 단축키 및 확대 동작 설정을 인게임 모드 메뉴에서 커스텀 가능[/*]
[/list]
